run_worker_loop: run the dataset viewer worker loop that processes jobs from the queue
run_worker_print_state_path: run the worker with --print-worker-state-path to print the state file path
create_app_config: create an AppConfig instance from environment variables using AppConfig.from_env
create_storage_client: create a StorageClient with S3 config, protocol, base URL, and overwrite enabled
create_job_runner_factory: create a JobRunnerFactory with app config, datasets cache, and storage client
